# contrast.semantic.condition { #fmrimod.contrast.semantic.condition }

```python
condition(level, *, term=None, basis_ix=None, basis=None)
```

Author a condition-level reference for semantic contrasts.

For most contrasts the string form is shorter:
``fit.contrast("face - house")`` parses to
``condition("face") - condition("house")``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Default    |
|----------|------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| level    | str                                                              | Level label as it appears in the events table (``"face"``).                                                                                                                                                                                        | _required_ |
| term     | str \| None                                                      | Term the level belongs to (``"trial_type"``, or ``"trial_type:rt"`` for a parametric-modulator slope). Optional when the level is unambiguous; a bare level that also appears in that term's own modulator slopes means the unmodulated condition. | `None`     |
| basis_ix | int \| tuple\[int, ...\] \| None                                 | 1-based basis column(s) to use for multi-basis HRFs (FIR, SPMG2/3).                                                                                                                                                                                | `None`     |
| basis    | Literal\[\'canonical\', \'derivative\', \'dispersion\'\] \| None | SPM informed-set role name instead of ``basis_ix``.                                                                                                                                                                                                | `None`     |
| not      |                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | _required_ |
| a        |                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | _required_ |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

``condition("gain") - condition("loss")`` creates a contrast that resolves
against declared design-column provenance rather than rendered column order.
``condition("listening", basis="canonical")`` pins the canonical column of
an SPMG2/SPMG3 informed basis set without spelling out ``basis_ix=1``.
